review: The battery died after two days. Waste of money.
Bought it as a gift and my sister loves it. Great quality!
It arrived on Tuesday in a brown box.
Works fine, but the fan is so loud I can't sleep next to it.
Huge upgrade over my old one, setup took five minutes.
The color is slightly darker than in the photos.
Customer support replaced my broken unit within a day. Impressed.
Stopped charging after a week and the seller ignores my emails.
The manual is available in English and German.
Oh great, another charger that melts. Exactly what I wanted.
